name: Coast Mountain Academy

geo.address: 3200 University Boulevard, Squamish, BC V8B 0N8 (register mailing address); school-location dataset gives 3295 Mamquam Road
geo.coord_source: BC Ministry school-location dataset 2025/2026 (3295 Mamquam Rd geocode); conflicts with the contact-register address — confirm campus

description: University-preparatory independent day school in Squamish for Grades 7–12 with an outdoor and 'Enriched Experiential Education' programme (trips, expeditions). Group 2 independent school.

attributes.philosophy: Self-described 'rigorous academic program complemented by ... fine arts, athletics, and outdoor education'; experiential trips (E3) and small classes.

legal_status.label: Independent school, Group 2 (Independent School Act, B.C.)
legal_status.authority: B.C. Ministry of Education and Child Care — Independent Schools Branch

attributes.qualifications_offered: B.C. Dogwood (Group 2 requirements as Group 1 for Grades 10–12).

tuition.notes: Student tuition $20,600 plus E3 experiential fee $1,675; school year not stated on the page (the same page still shows a 2024/25 application timeline).

attributes.additional_fees: Application $350; Futures Fund $5,000 per family (one-time, non-refundable); bus $400 (Squamish) or $2,160 (Whistler); uniform $300–400.
attributes.admission: Online application with documents; rolling admission.
attributes.transportation: Optional bus from Brackendale, Garibaldi Estates and Whistler.
advantages: Strong outdoor component in a mountain town
limitations: Primarily a conventional university-prep school with outdoor enrichment
attributes.qualifying_reason: Doubtful as a genuine alternative model: the official site describes a conventional university-preparatory programme with outdoor and experiential enrichment (SPEC §7 excludes regular schools merely advertising such features). Tuition has no school year. Kept as a candidate, not qualifying.
